Let's recap, Peter...

* I’m the America First conservative and political outsider running to defeat 50-year career politician Shady Sherrod Brown in **Ohio’s toss-up U.S. Senate race.**

* **President Donald Trump won Ohio in 2016 and 2020** , making it one of our best chances to flip a seat red in 2024.

* Democrats have a 2-seat majority, which means **we MUST flip Ohio** in order to restore a Republican majority that can work with a Trump White House to get our country back on track.

* **President Trump has endorsed my campaign** , and it’s been my privilege to campaign alongside him.

* The latest polls show Brown with a **5% lead** , just outside the margin of error.

* Brown is also leading _**ALL U.S. SENATE CANDIDATES**_ in fundraising, making ours one of the biggest challenges to overcome.

I hope you understand _**we have no choice**_ but to win this seat in Ohio. _But I’m behind_ – both in polling and fundraising.

I can’t win in Ohio unless I receive the same support _(or more)_ from you and our conservative grassroots base that Sherrod Brown is from his leftist base.

With more than 18 years of chumming it up with Washington Elite under his belt, it’s no wonder that the most powerful Democrats in the country are rushing to spend as much money as possible to secure a fourth Senate term for Jon Tester. Whether it’s the 25 million dollars Tester raised in 2023 or the more than 60 million dollars his friends in DC have earmarked to spend on TV ADS in Montana this fall, one thing is sure: Democrats know that I am the one who has what it takes to beat Jon Tester. Navy SEALS fight to win. We don’t quit, and we don’t lose. And Jon Tester is ripe for defeat. If Democrats didn’t invest another penny into Montana, which I assure you won’t be the case, the amount of money they’ve already invested would be akin to spending roughly more than $166,000 against me PER DAY. We can’t compete with them right now on the money front, but polls show that I CAN win in November. So today, Can I count on you to I need to step up and help me reach my June donor goal? When you read newspaper headlines in Montana and the national press, it’s clear that this race - and this state - will be the center of the political universe for the next six months. The amount of money Democrats have reserved to spend in Montana should tell you all you need to know about what’s at stake in this race. Let’s get this done. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Republican for U.S. Senate, Montana | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. Team, it’s Jason with some exciting news: **The General Election is here!** It’s the honor of a lifetime to serve the people of Colorado and have the opportunity to fight for hardworking families in Congress. I don’t take that privilege for granted. This is a team effort, so I wanted to thank you for your grassroots support. I learned in the military that you have to lead by example, no matter how tough the fight is. Now let me tell you about why I’m in the fight.
I’m somebody who is going to do my duty, regardless of the politics of it.
I’m going to defend this country because I love and believe in it.
For all of our faults, I still believe in the promise that we can move forward and be better together.
_That_ is the beauty of the American Dream.
But for too many, that dream is feeling harder and harder to reach. Medicine is expensive. They have to pick up a second or third job to put food on the table and a roof over their head. They have to worry about the threat of gun violence at school.
I know these struggles. Coming from a working-class family, I started working early to help put myself through college. I went active duty after 9/11 and joined the Army Rangers. I then came stateside and helped veterans secure their hard-earned benefits.
**At the end of the day, we all want the same thing: To build a good life.**
I believe Congress has a role to make peoples’ lives better — but the first step to doing that is to end the chaos and dysfunction in Washington.

clean_body: | Team, it’s Jason with some exciting news: The General Election is here! It’s the honor of a lifetime to serve the people of Colorado and have the opportunity to fight for hardworking families in Congress. I don’t take that privilege for granted. This is a team effort, so I wanted to thank you for your grassroots support. I learned in the military that you have to lead by example, no matter how tough the fight is. = This year will be no different: Extremists like Donald Trump and Lauren Boebert are going into this election determined to roll back our freedoms. We are the only people standing in their way. I’m rolling up my sleeves to elect service-oriented leaders across the country — but with less than 100 days until Coloradans start receiving ballots, I need your help: = | = Now let me tell you about why I’m in the fight. I’m somebody who is going to do my duty, regardless of the politics of it. I’m going to defend this country because I love and believe in it. For all of our faults, I still believe in the promise that we can move forward and be better together. That is the beauty of the American Dream. But for too many, that dream is feeling harder and harder to reach. Medicine is expensive. They have to pick up a second or third job to put food on the table and a roof over their head. They have to worry about the threat of gun violence at school. I know these struggles. Coming from a working-class family, I started working early to help put myself through college. I went active duty after 9/11 and joined the Army Rangers. I then came stateside and helped veterans secure their hard-earned benefits. At the end of the day, we all want the same thing: To build a good life. I believe Congress has a role to make peoples’ lives better — but the first step to doing that is to end the chaos and dysfunction in Washington. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Thank you for entrusting me with your support. Onward to November! Jason Crow | Now more than ever, we need strong leaders like Jason working for us in Congress. Jason is fighting for you, your family, and the American people in Congress — and he's not taking a dime of corporate PAC money. Will you pitch in now to help him continue working for us? | = Jason Crow for Congress 8547 E Arapahoe Road, STE J-543 Greenwood Village, CO 80112 United States | mailto:info@jasoncrowforcongress.com | Paid for by Jason Crow for Congress Jason Crow was a Captain in the U.S. Army. Adam

# **Making College Affordable in Pennsylvani** a
[**WATCH: Senator Hughes shares an update on the fight for free and affordable higher education**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168126.172146.13&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11156) **[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168126.172146.13&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11156)** Lawmakers are currently working on negotiating Pennsylvania's next budget which could impact many aspects of life in Pennsylvania, including public education, public safety, and affordable housing. They are also talking about ways to make higher education more affordable. Both Democrats and Republicans have said that affordable college is a top priority as they discuss how to invest PA's nearly $14 billion dollar surplus, signaling that reform for PA higher education is on the way. **Senator Hughes first led on the idea of free and affordable college when he introduced his[PA Promise legislation in 2017](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168126.172146.13&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11157). The idea of PA Promise was to provide funding to cover any tuition and fees at state-owned, state-related and community colleges, after federal and state grants have been provided, to students who come from families who make under $200K a year.** In January 2024, Governor Shapiro proposed a comprehensive plan to make the state's higher ed system more cost effective & to better serve students in PA. And then in June, Senate Republicans introduced the Grow Pennsylvania Scholarship Grant. The Grow PA Scholarship actually offers a similar proposal to what PA Promise would deliver for Pennsylvania college students. It recently passed the Senate. The job of a lawmaker is to advocate and work on behalf of their constituents. Senator Hughes has known for some time that the cost of college is too high for too many and student loans are making it nearly impossible to have financial stability after college. Affordable college is possible, and we're happy to see lawmakers put politics aside to find a solution for students. [Visit our website to learn more about the higher education bills that have passed in the Senate and PA Promise.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168126.172146.13&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11158)

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We’ll be honest, this isn’t the email we hoped to send you.

After being pummeled with $20 million from right-wing outside spending,
Rep. Jamaal Bowman has lost his primary election in NY-16. This was the
most expensive House primary in U.S. electoral history, with Republican
megadonors using AIPAC’s Super PAC to spend over $17 million against our
progressive incumbent.

Despite this disappointing news, Jamaal remains one of the most
transformational leaders of our generation. He has become a political
force who, alongside the rest of the Squad, has changed the trajectory of
American politics and the urgency we expect from our elected leaders.

We recruited Jamaal to run for Congress in 2020 because his life’s work
has been deeply rooted in serving his community — as a loving father,
husband, and community leader serving children and working families as a
principal and leading advocate for public education in NYC for over 15
years.

Jamaal was an underdog from the beginning, with our progressive movement
always facing an uphill battle. From the moment Justice Democrat
candidates are recruited to run, they are up against decades of
establishment infrastructure and multi-million dollar war chests fueled by
right-wing millionaires and billionaires.

The work of Justice Democrats is to break down the barriers that exist for
people like Jamaal Bowman to run for Congress. Through your contributions,
we have:

* Worked directly with Jamaal’s campaign to help them knock on 170,000
doors and make over 1,000,000 phone calls to voters this calendar
year;
* Raised the campaign over $200,000 directly from all of you on our
email list;
* Spent more than $1,300,000 on the independent expenditure side, making
us the largest outside group spender supporting Jamaal;
* Poured hundreds of staff hours into the campaign, stepping into key
management and communications roles when gaps existed, and closely
coordinating with and supporting Jamaal’s campaign staff.

Jamaal’s historic victory over 30+ year AIPAC darling Rep. Eliot Engel and
his courage on many key issues, especially on Israel’s genocide, made him
a top target.

Jamaal and our movement were such a threat to right-wing power, to GOP
megadonors, and to AIPAC’s influence in Congress that they had to spend
$15 million to defeat us. This demonstrates the power of our people-funded
movement, the strength that any single progressive with the moral clarity
to stand up to far-right interests has, and just how on defense AIPAC
really is.

For AIPAC — the single largest spender in American politics including the
Presidency to date — this race is so much bigger than re-electing a
Congressman. It is part of their final attempts to stop a rising tide of a
new generation of voters and leaders who refuse to stay silent in the face
of injustice at home or abroad.

AIPAC knows the future is not on their side, so they have no choice but to
overwhelm, confuse, and depress voters with a flood of dark money to
generate support for their candidates. That’s exactly why they pledged to
spend an unprecedented $100 million to unseat the Squad this year.

The sheer quantity of spending against our progressive champions proves to
us that our mission is not only a just and popular one that represents the
interests of the majority, but it is such a threat to the existing power
structures that they will spend more money than they ever have in their
history to try to silence us. It is up to us as a progressive movement,
and as a Democratic Party as a whole, to stand up and change this system
that sacrifices regular people for megadonors.

Win or lose, we know that primaries leave their mark on history and we
will never go back to a world where it is a given that members of Congress
will sell out our most marginalized communities and back down to corporate
interests. We will never go back to a world where all of Congress stays
silent as tens of thousands of people are murdered. Our members
relentlessly stand for a more just world for all people, even when it
threatens their own careers and well-being — as Jamaal selflessly did.

Now that this critical primary fight is over, we know AIPAC is shifting
gears and setting its sights on the next one: Rep. Cori Bush’s competitive
Democratic primary on August 6 in Missouri’s 1st district. We cannot give
in to hopelessness or cynicism — we must fight back, NOW.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240625-2.dg3uGI&refcode=em20240625-35476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35476%2E1203867%2ERCt2oD ]We need the grassroots resources to help protect Cori from AIPAC and
other right-wing attacks. Will you make a $5 contribution
right now to help us re-elect her and the rest of the Squad this year?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240625-2.dg3uGI&refcode=em20240625-35476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1020&akid=35476%2E1203867%2ERCt2oD ]Contribute $5

Jamaal Bowman is not a warning, but a model for what every progressive
should aspire to be: uncompromisingly dedicated to the interests of their
constituents and unwilling to compromise on our core values for political
expediency.

Let’s come together in this difficult moment and do what it takes to stop
AIPAC from unseating another one of our progressive champions this summer.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

Jamaal’s historic victory over 30+ year AIPAC darling Rep. Eliot Engel and his courage on many key issues, especially on Israel’s genocide, made him a top target. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: zero abortions because of YOU
body:
You and I both know what’s at stake in 2024...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

You and I both know what’s at stake in 2024.

The Abortion Lobby wants abortion-on-demand – _including late-term, sex-selective, discriminatory, and more_ – FORCED on every state in the country.

**__And they want taxpayers to pay for every single abortion_!_**

Pro-Life Friend, they think they can get away with it . . . They think you and I can’t stop them. And they’ve got the media and many politicians in BOTH parties believing their LIES.

With the **End of Quarter** rapidly approaching on June 30th, this is our chance to prove we have the momentum to run the BIGGEST and BADDEST election year program in _Students for Life Action’s_ history!

**[So, would you please consider making your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or $25 to _Students for Life Action_ right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-y/)?**

Whether it’s battling pro-abortion Democrat politicians in November or exposing weak-kneed Republicans during the primary season, your support does make a tremendous difference.

For example, I saw this headline just the other day which made me immediately pump my fist in the air:

**_“Arkansas Reports 0 Abortions as Abortion Ban Saves Babies!”_**
Of course, successes like these don’t just materialize on their own!

As you may remember, _Students for Life Action_ activists fought long and hard to pass the _Unborn Child Protection Act (SB 6)_ in Arkansas in 2021.

This bill is a model we’ve used elsewhere, including a similar one in Oklahoma – _SB 612_ – that we helped pass in 2022.

And recently, pro-lifers in South Carolina beat not one, but TWO so-called “Republicans” who betrayed us the year prior by voting to KILL a similar life-saving bill.

_And they sent a THIRD to a runoff election!_

**So why does this matter?**

After our voter education worked in the South Carolina primary, _The Guardian_ wrote, _“Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.”_

You see, while state legislative battles may not seem that exciting to some, this is how we save lives and advance the battle to abolish abortion by:

**>>>** Building a clear majority of U.S. states with STRONG abortion prevention laws;

**>>>** Ensuring that the delegations sent from these pro-life states to Congress stand unapologetically for Life; and

**>>>** Promote and pass legislation to protect EVERY innocent preborn child in America!
So, your support is making a difference.

But even with primaries continuing, we must start focusing on November where the stakes have never been higher.

We simply **_HAVE_** to stop the Abortion Lobby from seizing total control of Washington, D.C.

**Former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-CA) already promised that Democrats would DESTROY the U.S. Senate’s filibuster to FORCE their abortion nightmare on the United States!**

Which is why your support is the biggest shot in the arm that the Pro-Life Movement needs right now to carry the momentum we have throughout the summer and into November!

**[So, will you please consider chipping in to _Students for Life Action’s_ election year programs with your most generous contribution of](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-j/):**

[**$500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-i/)**
[**$250](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-d/)**
[**$100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-h/)**
[**$50](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-k/)**
**[Even a gift of $25 or just $10 will have a huge impact in November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gwdlhl-duchtdja-u/)!**

Thank you for everything you’ve done and continue to do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zccah83jgpjdcjlm715frj0bs4a6db2g5f4vj4gg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq5bkd8ov6441n0knfusae75m5rptsi81b015s30_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkqr3vnulc4dpqegklpanpt05a44ga02chdpb8b8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0ik35597604b4gpbbs7vrbvqs9guu58o2i30gco_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf07ht0mtvmedbr11aisgdf1j9106s1v4m5bu4a8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs)”** on DVD today. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/be-the-first-to-get-hillsdales-new-c-s-lewis-dvd-set/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhc2k1buh30u6q79urr8c3hk6bihs1vheqqgpthg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o36cph2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray, ‘01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
“Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zdk8jjhdrf8il02s2jhh9ek6g3khtk1k20v2hk2o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o31cjh2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zl88kstjrbsgpjm4c52mnn9n5ihm7pb9orc4otkg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6o31cjh2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. name: Center for American Liberty
subject: We’re suing the YMCA
body:
If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?

| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdpdjbbm1o9at4eboavefets00cck94klfb0pf8o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6p76chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,Have you heard the news?We're suing the Olympic Peninsula YMCA and City of Port Townsend, Washington, on behalf of grandmother Julie Jaman.**[**Will you donate $35 or more right now to help fund this critical new lawsuit?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zc8gkdt7mi4dg3on5b80or9hrba0e5de919uq9io_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6p76chh2bs)** **** If grandmothers and little girls are no longer safe by themselves in a women's locker room at the YMCA – where are they safe?After all, the YMCA was founded to put Christian values into practice by developing a healthy body, mind, and spirit. But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough _enough_ , Friend?The answer is **now.** Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day **she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room.** The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. **Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave.** Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community.**[**Now you can see why I'm asking you to make a tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to help fund Julie's case.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ztufup2p7aflrmirj0pgrah9nen164v8hpkknkt0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6p76chh2bs)** My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the _Center for American Liberty_ – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. The way the YMCA and the City of Port Townsend treated a concerned grandmother isn't just outrageous – it's unconstitutional.The City of Port Townsend owns the pool and contracts with the YMCA to operate it. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. Here at the _Center for American Liberty_ , our unique strategy is taking down the Left in the courts. In fact, we have already won THREE Supreme Court cases. We are honored to fight in the courts to protect your freedom to say what you want, to live according to your conscience, and to pass on your conservative values to the next generation. That's why our attorneys filed a lawsuit to protect Julie's constitutional rights – and yours, Friend. Winning this case means preserving your rights to free speech and due process. Losing it means... well, that's just not an option.Because we're also talking about the safety and privacy of women and girls across America! **[**So can I count on you to donate $35 or more today to fund Julie's case and protect your own constitutional rights?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbp11ebtud943f0iggscd3hd13qlfj6cbgee2348_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6p76chh2bs)** My team and I will never stay silent as the left attacks our most basic freedoms. We also never shy away from a fight.Going head-to-head with giant liberal groups like the ACLU doesn't scare me. But it does mean we need to have the resources on hand for a dogfight. **[**That's why I'm asking you to make a generous donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zh1mv7u2chnice1geqait858bq6bfhkokuvd01ag_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie6p76chh2bs)** Thank you for helping us fight back against the radical left and its disgusting attacks on our children, our freedoms, and our constitutional rights.
---
| | God Bless,
---

---

But the "woke" culture has infected even trusted ministries like this one. When is enough enough , Friend?The answer is now. Julie Jaman is an 82-year-old grandmother who regularly used her local swimming pool – until the day she found a grown man – wearing a women's bathing suit – watching two little girls undress in the women's locker room. The children appeared to be around four and six years old, and Julie believed she may be witnessing a predator in action. So, she did what any reasonable grandmother would do. Julie confronted the man and asked him to leave. Instead of asking the man to leave the women's locker room, the YMCA staff targeted Julie for her "discriminatory" behavior and banned her from that location for life. They also launched a smear campaign to paint Julie as a bigot and transphone in her community. My name is Harmeet Dhillon and I am the founder and Chief Executive Officer of the Center for American Liberty – the conservative non-profit organization underwriting Julie’s case. Like you, Julie has a First Amendment right to speak her mind on publicly owned property no matter who disagrees with it. And like you, she has a Fourteenth Amendment right to due process – something the YMCA working with the City of Port Townsend – neglected when they banned Julie for life without even hearing her side of the story. name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
“Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhkninheds5i4v60040g8kbdk28svjpjr2q4etc0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1os293td7q95cab9ng0jkmbhekch5fbaqh24qdo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2fmgogv2uvbe2jg57kcos02nua2qb712evddj6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zlis5bh2gcl0s79nsghqpgt8r92ngraldihv2200_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

subject: My New Book: Swimming Against the Current
body:
Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them.

| Dear Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them.
Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the **Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute.** My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. [Together, you and I will fight against insanity like this:](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg75l78cfuklrgg5vm82eajii807sg1thk4qjdf8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs) Women already fought for equality. _Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women._ Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. Friend, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. **But now they’re trying to erase all women**. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, [I hope you will stand with me by donating $500, $250, $100, $50, or even $25 right now!](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqu6b62gfei6ghkubn9u7je9ds8ddr5pg8i4p9k0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs) At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. [Please join us with your most generous gift today.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt65bb6pqroaem30rfgaf1uebces71ing2mnhk48_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs) Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. Sincerely, Riley Gaines Director, The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

name: Alan Dershowitz
subject: Too many newspapers get things wrong
body:
The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqjl8n00t6n1hn1svcjh4vibtr59hjhreqjs82b0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)
---
|

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4upnfhhmn53a5aevr6a6doimfg0m7q1njq5rp70_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)
---
**FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ** Dear Friend, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right. In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts. **The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.** Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. **The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. **[I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze01nlohd47lfdm4nkfs99ei6pmu1eu1bvcof6vg_rp22sh2s8i6ep34spie9or1c5h2bs)**

subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
"Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ec447330a34247fc99f592cabba09871&_e=zypDCpLPxOZeTRPmLZkK0Q7N-fH031pbw8GKZPrF-CTte75CgCZJWWxsRJQEluiGLL7pKjJiXA-oGkfEvOi4PfoaJC60Tz_udUeVNWfjaqLBSec3JiC9mwXUUKo2a1-bNYEprldRHL6sIGL7mcvRsf_PlT-AVqkzVuf-SLDuBSPfKHwsOyv5JKsDf2nwk6EMI1l7sppkM98fcee_A84iV4k1jwc4BQeAk6dSYQ3Y74ndoKf-q8P1WUJtDmTewh5PKqoAv8N7Ff7p3ZSyIfe_Uw%3D%3D)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ec447330a34247fc99f592cabba09871&_e=zypDCpLPxOZeTRPmLZkK0Q7N-fH031pbw8GKZPrF-CTte75CgCZJWWxsRJQEluiGLL7pKjJiXA-oGkfEvOi4PfoaJC60Tz_udUeVNWfjaqLBSec3JiC9mwXUUKo2a1-bLoY_Et8UEYSnmpvV8qgIWW1a97Fmxniv_14RNuUFvCU6BRhdrqYO6zDMCnFCwb-4YRugze5CpmrhK9ggtl42d04H2pKlu-3nvolkPFHpzK_kp-FThh3hXaJgqO5A_eatOapUXtjcCL8txIhqIyI5mw%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ec447330a34247fc99f592cabba09871&_e=zypDCpLPxOZeTRPmLZkK0Q7N-fH031pbw8GKZPrF-CTte75CgCZJWWxsRJQEluiGLL7pKjJiXA-oGkfEvOi4PfoaJC60Tz_udUeVNWfjaqLBSec3JiC9mwXUUKo2a1-b0jTJYuH5ILD5Rf4Hakz5Z2sFBKkgi6a2N23FOw6kSKK7rDPD85rX1iYpNwUF2bfbCGVByb8Cl6kWOno3tonyac-ZnF3fSfBQ47yNmTraCaQ5Gq9sB-um5IWTPqfz9UeWTmu2cCrfXWJaq13lrjtz0A%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=ec447330a34247fc99f592cabba09871&_e=zypDCpLPxOZeTRPmLZkK0Q7N-fH031pbw8GKZPrF-CTte75CgCZJWWxsRJQEluiGLL7pKjJiXA-oGkfEvOi4PfoaJC60Tz_udUeVNWfjaqLBSec3JiC9mwXUUKo2a1-bPlBWYV32dVlaS6Eatkf1qgS6B6i5K65PHdebIp5VDfCYCCGmjQEltMRgXI0yRjgglshyMTqG-PZ_Zo-AYvqQ09y6iSxKB_gzawBcXaNjTxtXi7txNzFgE2Rz8Ahn2xP2U9YuPp9_RMMayrVbChdvog%3D%3D)
---
Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely, Seth Dillon
CEO, The Babylon Bee

body:
One of our most popular courses has been about a famous British author -- C.S. Lewis.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9381be7c684d4106b42a1f415284e5c7&_e=hyNlFhtbcfIIpX77qkZLzTv4WkrN0zcqKyPRdEJkizSDU3JBJ-BvYaVxnEDezn4wlki_glbKfQ45A7FnLnHhJrkeVooQqK-UHmLFXOxGYQbGPYhhTg0uHpiDhK53GKfdURS6RO55bvPjQhCnbApkgKQ9y_JKt0kDAnfPQvYhjwBohLckQWEXODUxx6cTqS_4n_RtfxnY2yV4-z2kd11CcT2gAlCO87B0ddmIh_DlcS-BkPDCavsCRaTX1Zn_eq_xXL9uqnlaUQGY3T5End8FM985Pcsbc6uGzhZhKeH54I1pap2p1-RBgZx4Oa9w6rJwlKU31TqZ4rRn1fp2jLj9vutOYoSLNm_n6-n2ZGi0x-G6LNRMUmzCqHwhwXWUAyWJlnNlvnb1WkoiVgXasszpmvvy6gwYF1CCtWmOsomeSuwpmkUMX_-j89QLSdZwXA3S) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I'm writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News _because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--like our free online courses. _ _ And though we're best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author--C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **"[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9381be7c684d4106b42a1f415284e5c7&_e=hyNlFhtbcfIIpX77qkZLzTv4WkrN0zcqKyPRdEJkizSDU3JBJ-BvYaVxnEDezn4wlki_glbKfQ45A7FnLnHhJrkeVooQqK-UHmLFXOxGYQbGPYhhTg0uHpiDhK53GKfdURS6RO55bvPjQhCnbApkgKQ9y_JKt0kDAnfPQvYhjwBohLckQWEXODUxx6cTqS_4n_RtfxnY2yV4-z2kd11CcT2gAlCO87B0ddmIh_DlcS-BkPDCavsCRaTX1Zn_eq_xXL9uqnlaUQGY3T5End8FM985Pcsbc6uGzhZhKeH54I2DUrq1dVbj3y9Kgr3-yUbtR8FuLqNCB1Lm1s-X6QJ35wjvXLzikGMOg8KPsahocxL_1QNGle-R18kkgQAA0vKQXYBo01iFC7Xomjp3z6H2VZ5LOnQ58Gb8gef8Qn7JHhiu6lWPbSFtHQi2uCPp439W)" **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. ## Julian Assange Freed in Plea Deal
WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange has been [freed from a U.K. prison](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwZstOGPsDgyVKksd0rWjdYHDuQhDBCRR3r5q587_8uv7Pm0n5Mhp_8KDbAt5Q9f4QZvpwfSgN915G4iAxo6smtWbVnJaVHexLpwXNweUOmiHXqngwmLMHMw4Lc5hxxYkaGnAKAlKq4FG453RKB16d_aT0JI8t1yGa-bULhTiKz-oDC4fXbSX1m5VjO8CVgErnl2iZx32_JsFrJ-pUUnYOCeMAtbrPTKmHmvFtFNf6J64UR_w4Pjqb4VrTgLW2nJ5iXFlL8YPpZSW4zSrrlh_e3KMXM0stNwP5Pj30f5XeVj4CQAA__9TnGYU) after reaching a plea agreement with U.S. prosecutors. He has been in some form of confinement for 14 years. Assange will plead guilty to one felony count of illegally obtaining classified information in a U.S. court in the Northern Mariana Islands, a distant U.S. territory in the Western Pacific, [early Wednesday morning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp_G7ogGjMd2QXGbdLntltYYhmQS_CMgifbtV9l6u-_TaY7O12W-kCTZrv9pZVfjPpOv8uIZlUFl7Gzb4CKz4a5lpwc9WQ39qNubi8Q2LD0HDbT0vR46ALaIntig11MrzoCxgAY1GG31iTsMHi2Bp-CX0DcWOEjd8-m-y1ZvHNP3_uJ88vvaJner9ShN968x58ac6dj4XT7oc3IVn_izSqHtyur-LFU8q8AH5bryVtWRmNRbHpKYHkUVkoM2Rc9SMyUhBcBLN8I4TDFih95Py6QxjiaOhoOFNrtwvCUlKTg0Fq4rSfp1q3-XejnzEwAA__8kHWxT). After the hearing, Assange will fly to Australia, his home country, where his wife, Stella, and their two young sons, who have never seen him outside of custody, will greet him. A U.S. federal grand jury [indicted Assange in 2019](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEb24ix5hYvX0OXaK9FiL2QTB1DsYOXvT7n6upGmGGm-L-OFJMm6fNGDfZm3kUKRg0fUgBrc6JroZ2bgrmFve_vPWXM62-bqpw4JgQ1ZDF00rofZGpzAYTi73mAjHgw4g4DWgHW25Q5jQEcmUAxTPClnOErZnu1tk7VceU7v7eBnG7ZHk_y1lD2r7r-CQcFQa23DlFeu-eMVDB9UMNxeSWjVlDOtC-sqd0lM96z3xBSzXl6Syltz3mVbaWFNoSgYmqePe5WUJGOvnFkeJOm3XP7-cHj4CQAA___D1mGA) for illegally obtaining and sharing classified information about the Afghanistan and Iraq wars. He has been in British custody since then, fighting extradition to the United States.
## Starliner Remains Stuck in Space
Boeing's Starliner's return to Earth has [already been delayed three times](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwTEgyMDSDpybq1tHC8GxTYYjgOZb_vkrnTjfccrrv-3C3IYY0P-yKhqY8WEfhhYPmoDmoQTXeTIiAXYNGnuVVSXG6yGYxDt2IVy-F6qwdnToJqXFUGhxMXstLEwwIUEKDlgKkki122jutrHDWu9GfmBLoA-XS_uSQaMEpHvmFpXV5baJZiJ6VdR8Megb9vu_tWtPbMegx8a0y6BPubxC6JeWY54NBX8mWGBIWXpC2kvgUw7wQ9xjtgZ5viULk0RIWTkuovG7rioVBbwu_3WR-fNJXU4x_7iHGUPWZKTGvNsS_MPp_08vAbwAAAP__URJtMg) due to leaks and other problems, and the spacecraft remains docked at the International Space Station indefinitely, according to NASA. The capsule, carrying astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams, launched on June 5 and [was supposed to return on June 14](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHOozAQhJ_GdI7sxRhSuLiGLtdeiRa8BF8cG9kLUd7-xNV_t9J-82k0fx7TA0MM6fkb3-R4zRMuHE6arAQrwUym8W4lAmobcrrXd6NVN-hmc_PQ9WtPwzAYY2drZ23BtwP1Bu59N7dNcKDAKAtWK9BG36i1frEG1YJ-mX0njCIfOJfb3xwSb7TGbz6p3Jb8bqLbmPcq2l8CRgFj-u658vUSMF5iAaOy190KGI8qE33qxWFF-Ur0kXOmkJ6yMpYYEhW5oZeh1oOqnGnNhWTEIy2bjITnhWLlkhMeXGXlY3lJ5CsgC-258GVvivP7J8QYqu2FUc83hvi_L_-83ungXwAAAP__NQdzHQ) following a short visit to the ISS. NASA says the earliest possible return is now an unspecified date in July. NASA officials permitted Boeing to launch despite a small helium leak after determining it wasn't dangerous. However, the Starliner developed four additional leaks in orbit, and five thrusters failed. Boeing reports that four thrusters are now fixed, but they're still [investigating the cause of the issues](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFywyAQheHToA4NrNbIKijSqHPalBpAa4kEgwfW1vj2GadO_Zrv_V-X5eJiinn7dDeyfC2LCxyftBgJRgIu2K32SgQ0dGT1qCfU6nTW3W71OiIobyaEYRpHb84egw9IhNrgpLtoQQEqA0Yr0Kh7GswaDDoV3Br8ehKoaI1cav9dYuadrulVnlT7UG5dsjvzvYnhQ8AsYD6Oo6_0YKrtvQuYmcKeSyrbS8Dc7i6QgHkvh_SFYt6abOxqipmqDC5LX2PeZOQmXeNasntwk96FH0mu8i7fWKnepwXMXbXr_YgpxWZGgWq7uZj-XPx_paeF3wAAAP__vQxqrg).

subject: The Sun's re-emergence is a gift...
body:
In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/cF9piUvLmxYVmqwo1iU0Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRoXotiP0TZaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2duc29meWNjcWg_~~)

---
**FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ** Dear Friend, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right. In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts. **The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.** Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. **The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. **[I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. ](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/cF9piUvLmxYVmqwo1iU0Ww~~/AARclAA~/RgRoXotiP0TZaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2duc29meWNjcWg_~~)**

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf605dd53-de47-437f-8df6-67b53ac547ce/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, I have served this country my entire life. Now that I’ve retired from the US Army as a Brigadier General, I’m ready to continue my service in a new arena. I live in the Georgia district currently represented by Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think my neighbors deserve better. Over the course of 40 years in the armed forces, I served our country in various capacities, including as an infantry commander in Afghanistan following the tragic events of 9/11. I ultimately worked as a senior military advisor at military posts around the world. That means I was providing strategic guidance and leadership to keep our nation strong against foreign adversaries. I took an oath to protect the US Constitution from all enemies, foreign AND domestic. When I left the Army to start my farm here in North Georgia, I discovered that my country still needed me. The current US Congress is the weakest, most chaotic legislature in my memory, and my district is right at the heart of it. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T705d828e-afdc-4e4f-889b-5db472920371/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I think Georgia deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think America deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. My background on both the enlisted and officer side of the armed forces has prepared me to address the complex challenges facing our nation today. That starts with core American values we are severely lacking from some of our elected officials today.
---
|

| I’m taking on MTG so we can bring sanity back to Washington. We don’t need chaos and childish tantrums from our elected officials, we need basic, steady leadership. I find that the people I talk to mostly agree: we need better, we deserve better, and it’s time to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene with someone focused on what’s best for America rather than what’s best for herself. [**If you also agree that MTG needs to be defeated, I’m asking for your help.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09bd23bc-1947-426d-9f8a-6730c68d488e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement >>>

| Dear Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them.
Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the **Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute.** My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. [Together, you and I will fight against insanity like this: ](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMzz1u5CAUAODT4M7W4_FnFxSrXblZTZQuJcLw7EHDGAs8Seb2UXKCXOCTvreLu_iU0769-DvZW6iuNufJbT7t1PpnedQ-lOPpEFD2oHvUjnfRxilorzuy3PBJgkIO3dUuEkehRonI_arWFYUwgi8eJBgVJ9Ml--2ARs25VEIOXANX67TqUcNoIjAJPlM9hxvREcq-VWqt0vFYcgp-H0K5d9lez_NoTPxhODOcj888pHYynM11oUSxQGNibuVRA7lQIjHx7__fVwVmxK7aeHyknFPThknY7j7lH_b8df_d4lcAAAD__66KYU8) Women already fought for equality. _Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women._ Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. Friend, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. **But now they’re trying to erase all women**. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, [ I hope you will stand with me by donating $500, $250, $100, $50, or even $25 right now!](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMzz1u5CAUAODT4M7W4_FnFxSrXblZTZQuJcLw7EHDGAs8Seb2UXKCXOCTvreLu_iU0769-DvZW6iuNufJbT7t1PpnedQ-lOPpEFD2oHvUjnfRxilorzuy3PBJgkIO3dUuEkehRonI_arWFYUwgi8eJBgVJ9Ml--2ARs25VEIOXANX67TqUcNoIjAJPlM9hxvREcq-VWqt0vFYcgp-H0K5d9lez_NoTPxhODOcj888pHYynM11oUSxQGNibuVRA7lQIjHx7__fVwVmxK7aeHyknFPThknY7j7lH_b8df_d4lcAAAD__66KYU8) At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. [ Please join us with your most generous gift today. ](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMzz1u5CAUAODT4M7W4_FnFxSrXblZTZQuJcLw7EHDGAs8Seb2UXKCXOCTvreLu_iU0769-DvZW6iuNufJbT7t1PpnedQ-lOPpEFD2oHvUjnfRxilorzuy3PBJgkIO3dUuEkehRonI_arWFYUwgi8eJBgVJ9Ml--2ARs25VEIOXANX67TqUcNoIjAJPlM9hxvREcq-VWqt0vFYcgp-H0K5d9lez_NoTPxhODOcj888pHYynM11oUSxQGNibuVRA7lQIjHx7__fVwVmxK7aeHyknFPThknY7j7lH_b8df_d4lcAAAD__66KYU8) Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. clean_body: My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement >>> | Dear Friend, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them. Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. Women already fought for equality. Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women. Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. Friend, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. But now they’re trying to erase all women. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. The Republican Party has long been associated with a philosophy of lower taxes. This stance is deeply rooted in the party's core principles and has been a consistent feature of its economic policy platform.
Central to the Republican Party's belief in lower taxes is the economic theory of supply-side economics. This theory says that lower taxes can encourage people and businesses to work and invest more. This, in turn, leads to increased productivity, job creation, and overall economic prosperity.
The Laffer Curve, a concept often associated with supply-side economics, suggests that there is an optimal tax rate that maximizes government revenue. Republicans know that if taxes are too high, people are discouraged from working or investing, leading to a decrease in economic activity and, consequently, tax revenue.
The Republican Party also believes in a limited role for government in the economy. This belief is rooted in the party's emphasis on individual freedom and personal responsibility. By lowering taxes, individuals and businesses keep more of their hard-earned money, enabling them to make their own economic decisions without excessive government interference.
Moreover, lower taxes can lead to a more efficient allocation of resources. We know that the private sector is more efficient than the government in allocating resources and that lower taxes allow for more resources to be directed by the market, leading to better economic outcomes.
The Republican Party's belief in lower taxes has also been shaped by historical events. The party's stance on taxes has often been a reaction to excessive government spending and taxation. For example, during the Reagan administration, the Republican Party pushed for significant tax cuts as a response to excessive government spending and high inflation. By lowering the highest individual tax rate from 70% to 30% the U.S. saw one of the largest economic recoveries in our history.
The Mississippi Republican Party outlines its belief on taxes in its platform stated below;
_Mississippi Republicans believe that people, not government, know best how to spend their own money. When people keep more of their hard-earned money, jobs and economic growth will flourish in the free market system._
_Mississippi Republicans support the reduction of the tax burden on our citizens. We believe our tax burden is too high, our tax code is too complicated, and our tax system is inefficient. We believe in the reduction of taxes to empower taxpayers, to create a more competitive_
_environment for job creation, to incentivize work, entrepreneurship, and investment, and to prevent the excessive growth of government._
_We support an overhaul of our state and federal tax codes to address the problems of the current systems, to stimulate economic growth and to establish a firm, fair and equitable foundation for collecting revenues to pay for essential government services._
The Tippah County Republican Party encourages you to contact your elected officials and ask them to re-affirm their commitment to the Republican Party Platform and to lower your taxes.

| | Friend, I'm not going to mince words. _Every conservative patriot should be alarmed_.

I'm reaching out to encourage you to make a plan to tune in at 9:00 pm ET this Thursday for the first GOP Presidential debate.| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=ef10b7678b154d7ba191b3d385f1c589&_e=RUaHeGYkS8JTC_KBcW2fKBZNNuh58DGnivSExkS0sfZEmsy1tqws0FfjqTw38fZ3gcZioPxcDaFglNhGt0CllZnTJm9kbptuC_EcRjPgEaEIujCWet9eQ4aPYuBTdA_re57Y89l2rwqjLjztMcCsl_EX32KRQJgXuAbPWPVfXyXuAQT_QEMJwNUUQ_btKA1BwcqneVaeH-DVT6VHXVEVQQ%3D%3D)

Peter, While the repeat selection of Presidents Joe Biden and Donald Trump as their party's presumptive nominees may turn off many voters, it would be wrong to assume that we already know everything either of them would do if elected this November. In Thursday night’s debate, they owe it to the American people to be candid about their vision for America's future. **I'm reaching out to encourage you to tune in at 9:00 pm ET this Thursday for the first GOP Presidential debate. Make that your plan now and stick to it!**

These may be the same two candidates, but this isn't the same election as 2020 being played all over again. Think of the differences, with the rapid emergence of new technologies, the nation's recovery from the COVID pandemic, the wars in Ukraine and Israel, Trump's serious legal issues, the violence at our nation's capital on January 6, and the state of America's economy. It’s a very different election, in fact a very different and more dangerous world.

When I think about all of this, I’m more convinced than ever that this is the most important presidential debate since 1980 when Ronald Reagan had to convince Americans that he was up to the job, especially when it came to foreign relations.

If you don't watch the debate live and make your own judgement about these two individuals...if you instead watch short clips prepared within the silos of the influencers you follow, you will be seeing a version of reality that has already passed through the lens of someone else's bias.

You owe it to yourself as an American citizen and someone who is concerned with our country's future to watch this debate and make your own judgments.

Will one of these candidates have their moment in this debate and really break away from expectations? Time will tell, but it's important that we all stay engaged in our democracy and give each candidate a fair chance to make their case. The best way to do that is to watch Thursday and hear what they have to say.

I look forward to speaking with you again soon to share with you my thoughts about the debate.
---
I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John

clean_body: I'm reaching out to encourage you to make a plan to tune in at 9:00 pm ET this Thursday for the first GOP Presidential debate.| | | Peter, While the repeat selection of Presidents Joe Biden and Donald Trump as their party's presumptive nominees may turn off many voters, it would be wrong to assume that we already know everything either of them would do if elected this November. In Thursday night’s debate, they owe it to the American people to be candid about their vision for America's future. I'm reaching out to encourage you to tune in at 9:00 pm ET this Thursday for the first GOP Presidential debate. Make that your plan now and stick to it! These may be the same two candidates, but this isn't the same election as 2020 being played all over again. Think of the differences, with the rapid emergence of new technologies, the nation's recovery from the COVID pandemic, the wars in Ukraine and Israel, Trump's serious legal issues, the violence at our nation's capital on January 6, and the state of America's economy. It’s a very different election, in fact a very different and more dangerous world. When I think about all of this, I’m more convinced than ever that this is the most important presidential debate since 1980 when Ronald Reagan had to convince Americans that he was up to the job, especially when it came to foreign relations. If you don't watch the debate live and make your own judgement about these two individuals...if you instead watch short clips prepared within the silos of the influencers you follow, you will be seeing a version of reality that has already passed through the lens of someone else's bias. You owe it to yourself as an American citizen and someone who is concerned with our country's future to watch this debate and make your own judgments. Will one of these candidates have their moment in this debate and really break away from expectations? Time will tell, but it's important that we all stay engaged in our democracy and give each candidate a fair chance to make their case. The best way to do that is to watch Thursday and hear what they have to say. I look forward to speaking with you again soon to share with you my thoughts about the debate. I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. name: John Avlon
subject: We did it!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN AVLON FOR CONGRESS
body:
Friends, we did it! This is a long email -- but I hope you'll read it and join in our excitement and gratitude.

We showed that the politics of addition can defeat the politics of division – and that will be the key to finally flipping this swing seat and winning in November.

Despite all the serious challenges our community and our country face, this is the time to be happy warriors – knowing that we are fighting the good fight, side by side and unafraid.

I want to congratulate Nancy Goroff on running a hard-fought race – but now it’s time for all Suffolk County Democrats to come together. We need to unite so that we can fire up the base and then – because Democrats are the last big tent party that believes in bipartisanship - reach out with clarity and confidence and get after the real business of winning this election and winning back Congress.

From the very beginning of this campaign - just 126 days ago - I was clear about our goals and vision for winning.

I said that we would build a broad patriotic coalition to defend American democracy by defeating Donald Trump and helping Democrats taking back the House. Our general election campaign begins NOW - if you're with me, can you pitch in to make sure we win back this seat?

We here in Suffolk County are lucky to live in a swing district - most Americans don’t - and that’s what’s led to the poisonous hyper partisanship that has frustrated so many of us.

But here we can do something about it. We can be the change we want to see. Because winning in a swing district requires the politics of addition, not division.

It requires reaching out and bringing people together.

And that’s what we’ve done to date – bringing together the New Democratic Coalition in Congress – with leaders like Congressman Tom Suozzi and Greg Meeks – as well as the hard-working Teachers Union and the heroic healthcare workers of 1199/SEIU.

We’ve got to continue bringing people together around common sense problem solving over the next stage of this campaign. Because the real work starts now.

I want to close with this: I've always believed that politics is history in the present tense. This is our chance to write a new chapter of the American story. It means taking responsibility for what happens on our watch.

We are called upon to overcome extremism and division in our nation and prove once again of fundamental strength and character of American democracy.

So today, let’s savor the victory that we have achieved together– and then tomorrow rededicate ourselves to the larger effort at hand - building an even stronger campaign, focused on winning the general election.

Thank you for continuing to fight this good fight with me.

On to November!

-John

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6793%2E5257348%2EWHe6L6 ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —
today, I’m celebrating one of the most important anniversaries of Pride
Month.

Nine years ago today, the Supreme Court issued a 5-4 decision in
Obergefell v. Hodges recognizing marriage equality nationwide.

It’s a far cry from the Supreme Court’s far-right politics today — and
proof that the Court can still be a lodestar for national progress if we
have the will to make it so.

Generations of LGBTQIA+ activists struggled and sacrificed in the fight
for equal rights and full recognition of their humanity by our government.
Their efforts paid off with the Obergefell decision and blazed a path for
our passage of the Respect for Marriage Act to codify marriage equality
into federal law in 2022.

But Mitch McConnell made it his mission to remake the federal judiciary in
Trump’s flawed image. When Justice Antonin Scalia passed and President
Obama nominated Merrick Garland to fill his vacancy, McConnell denied
Garland a hearing for almost an entire year.

When Trump won the 2016 election, McConnell and the Republican Senate were
quick to confirm Neil Gorsuch in his place, followed by Brett Kavanaugh,
and then in the final days of the 2020 election, as millions of votes had
already been cast, and against the dying wish of the late Justice Ruth
Bader Ginsberg, McConnell hypocritically pushed through the confirmation
of Trump’s third Supreme Court justice nominee, Amy Coney Barrett.

Trump and McConnell fundamentally changed the Supreme Court, and hard-line
conservative Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas have grown more
emboldened, political, and partisan than any justices in living memory.

Thomas has accepted millions of dollars in previously undisclosed gifts
from wealthy megadonors with interests before the Supreme Court, while his
wife coordinated with Trump White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows on
January 6th.

The Alitos have publicly flown flags associated with QAnon and the MAGA
insurrectionists.

But there is good news. Thanks to our defense of the Senate majority in
2022, President Biden is now outpacing Trump in filling the federal bench.

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek — today, I’m celebrating one of the most important anniversaries of Pride Month. Nine years ago today, the Supreme Court issued a 5-4 decision in Obergefell v. Hodges recognizing marriage equality nationwide. It’s a far cry from the Supreme Court’s far-right politics today — and proof that the Court can still be a lodestar for national progress if we have the will to make it so. Generations of LGBTQIA+ activists struggled and sacrificed in the fight for equal rights and full recognition of their humanity by our government. Their efforts paid off with the Obergefell decision and blazed a path for our passage of the Respect for Marriage Act to codify marriage equality into federal law in 2022. But Mitch McConnell made it his mission to remake the federal judiciary in Trump’s flawed image. When Justice Antonin Scalia passed and President Obama nominated Merrick Garland to fill his vacancy, McConnell denied Garland a hearing for almost an entire year. When Trump won the 2016 election, McConnell and the Republican Senate were quick to confirm Neil Gorsuch in his place, followed by Brett Kavanaugh, and then in the final days of the 2020 election, as millions of votes had already been cast, and against the dying wish of the late Justice Ruth Bader Ginsberg, McConnell hypocritically pushed through the confirmation of Trump’s third Supreme Court justice nominee, Amy Coney Barrett. Trump and McConnell fundamentally changed the Supreme Court, and hard-line conservative Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas have grown more emboldened, political, and partisan than any justices in living memory. Thomas has accepted millions of dollars in previously undisclosed gifts from wealthy megadonors with interests before the Supreme Court, while his wife coordinated with Trump White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows on January 6th. The Alitos have publicly flown flags associated with QAnon and the MAGA insurrectionists. But there is good news. Thanks to our defense of the Senate majority in 2022, President Biden is now outpacing Trump in filling the federal bench. I believe we need to go even further — I have introduced legislation in the House and will champion the same in the Senate, to expand the Supreme Court from nine justices to thirteen, while imposing an enforceable code of ethics and term limits so that the youth of today do not have to live under the yoke of this far-right Court for decades to come. We discuss:
* The role of 19th and 20th-century American religion broadly
* The role of African American Islam, the modern Civil Rights Movement, and Islam in the West
* The pioneering role of Indian Ahmadiyya Muslims and African Americans in the
development of Islam in America

**These values have informed my "why" – why**** I ran to serve in the Senate in the first place and why I'm running for reelection so I can continue fighting for working families like mine.** But to be honest, as I face my toughest race yet, I can't win without your help today.

It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem

| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T38155786-4625-4db5-9522-ae673468087c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1080ece4-01ec-4c56-888b-40b80a998fc7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. name: David Horowitz
subject: I’m not saying this to scare you
body:
I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zodh4u32amsv8g9v7hu5r2df1pjtc71b21jrmgho_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s5h64pb7chh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt.
