---
| | Your compassionate support today can empower our teams to deliver Bibles where they are needed most. From Iran to Pakistan, Iraq to Egypt, and Mozambique, persecuted believers, especially those who have left Islam, are hungering for the Word of God in their native tongue.

The impact of providing persecuted Christians with access to God's Word cannot be overstated. It can mean the difference between a newfound believer standing firm in their faith or wavering forever in their new faith.

The Apostle Paul assures us in Romans chapter 10 that "faith comes through hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ." That means that your gift is an eternal investment in the lives of those who dare to hope amidst persecution.

Consider the testimony of believers like Kasim, a secret church leader and former Muslim, for whom the Bible is a lifeline and a source of truth. Or Isaac, another former Muslim turned Bible smuggler, who, despite the risks, cannot hide the compelling light of Scripture.

Every day, these courageous men -- and thousands of their brothers and sisters -- live among Christians and churches hungering for the spiritual nourishment they need. Like the people of Israel journeying through the wilderness, they're crying out for the "true bread from heaven" (John 6:32) that will sustain them.

That's why every Bible we're able to deliver is cherished and proclaimed with unwavering faith, even in the face of persecution.

**I cannot stress the urgency and importance of this mission. Every Bible smuggled into these dark places is nothing short of a miracle.**

And we need many more miracles!

[**_Will you join us in this vital work by making a special gift today to provide God's Word to our suffering brothers and sisters in Christ?_**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c3bcb3c7200d421cbc5ef31efb1438cd&_e=eFr3ASxQvjQkyfBnRjrz8paZYU6Rnhdq55kIT9fwVcBSEitN8uRmay7ArkTjfowvgRbutrOVt-_aL_m_2yByB1zxjCj02isVXfjBU71QSH7HkFF0NHd9QIfOLtxjL4ScW44sJTnkX5jX1JQUc9S5ilpETXJ_iu2Kejk3yY89BB2Awfmw70wG8zWxyK3y5pJ4kfPxc_MjDXeAQ1srRWsyfl6Puhjh8tI79RzW3v2FOY1BxOQSLP-069_NM-JobN1Tk921YRwdd2Lp18c5bTy9uHKQYmtEckOepypqduxUrWr114X8_cIGJ5CpWRB8piZiZdSmoi0IpMXlF8bWSs0Q6yH5hhHvAvGBvgVt3sisFPMjru_jqOD3spRVw1oJWkx2FJEP2A9Kx0LaGqJXub3j8kCuaoN9Q4K-qqQpOFWlZJfVm6bhc_MRqZDnTnVuqhTn)

Consider for a moment how precious God's word is in your life. I imagine you probably resonate with the prophet Jeremiah, who said, "Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a joy and the delight of my heart, for I am called by your name, O LORD, God of hosts" (Jer. 15:16).

What an amazing blessing it is to have God's revealed Word readily at hand!

But now imagine the sorrow that our brothers and sisters must feel when they can't turn to God's Word for joy, delight, assurance, and peace. Surely they resonate with the psalmist's cry, "As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God" (Psalm 42:1)!

GCR and our partners are committed to delivering as many Bibles to these Christians as possible. But we cannot do it without your help.

Your gift of $50 delivers 10 Bibles for believers to have a Bible study together. And a generous gift of $150 could bless an even larger home church fellowship with 30 Bibles! Whatever you are able to give, I urge you to give generously, knowing that you are investing in the eternity of precious brothers and sisters in Christ.

If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | | Dear Co-Laborer for Christ, "Please, we need Bibles!" As you read these words, countless persecuted Christians around the globe are yearning for something many of us take for granted: access to God 's word. The Lord Jesus himself -- the Word incarnate -- proclaimed, "I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me shall not hunger, and whoever believes in me shall never thirst" (John 6:35). But under the persecution of hostile and oppressive regimes, many of our brothers and sisters in Christ are spiritually starving for lack of access to God's Word. In these countries, the possession of a Bible is not just restricted; it's often deemed illegal -- and in many cases can be dangerous! Yet in spite of persecution, the demand continues to grow, which is why, here at Global Christian Relief (GCR), we are tirelessly working to print and distribute Bibles in these challenging regions. Brave believers risk their lives to smuggle these precious Scriptures into secret house churches, underground networks, and communities of converts from Islam. But to continue the work and provide much-needed spiritual nourishment to these oppressed believers, we rely on the generous partnership of kingdom-minded friends like you. | | Your compassionate support today can empower our teams to deliver Bibles where they are needed most. From Iran to Pakistan, Iraq to Egypt, and Mozambique, persecuted believers, especially those who have left Islam, are hungering for the Word of God in their native tongue. The impact of providing persecuted Christians with access to God's Word cannot be overstated. It can mean the difference between a newfound believer standing firm in their faith or wavering forever in their new faith. The Apostle Paul assures us in Romans chapter 10 that "faith comes through hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ." That means that your gift is an eternal investment in the lives of those who dare to hope amidst persecution. Consider the testimony of believers like Kasim, a secret church leader and former Muslim, for whom the Bible is a lifeline and a source of truth. Or Isaac, another former Muslim turned Bible smuggler, who, despite the risks, cannot hide the compelling light of Scripture. Every day, these courageous men -- and thousands of their brothers and sisters -- live among Christians and churches hungering for the spiritual nourishment they need. Like the people of Israel journeying through the wilderness, they're crying out for the "true bread from heaven" (John 6:32) that will sustain them. That's why every Bible we're able to deliver is cherished and proclaimed with unwavering faith, even in the face of persecution. I cannot stress the urgency and importance of this mission. Every Bible smuggled into these dark places is nothing short of a miracle. And we need many more miracles! Consider for a moment how precious God's word is in your life. I imagine you probably resonate with the prophet Jeremiah, who said, "Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a joy and the delight of my heart, for I am called by your name, O LORD, God of hosts" (Jer. 15:16). What an amazing blessing it is to have God's revealed Word readily at hand! But now imagine the sorrow that our brothers and sisters must feel when they can't turn to God's Word for joy, delight, assurance, and peace. Surely they resonate with the psalmist's cry, "As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God" (Psalm 42:1)! GCR and our partners are committed to delivering as many Bibles to these Christians as possible. But we cannot do it without your help. Your gift of $50 delivers 10 Bibles for believers to have a Bible study together. And a generous gift of $150 could bless an even larger home church fellowship with 30 Bibles! Whatever you are able to give, I urge you to give generously, knowing that you are investing in the eternity of precious brothers and sisters in Christ. Please don't delay. Our persecuted family in Christ is counting on us for their lifeline! Would you step forward? ## Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution?
[Yes](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2ddb1909d57b49e8a7d4fb0c98a9971e&_e=POr175x3_blJrB6CeaOntYyC1BSOmPNbOtR0DRYwHU8EMsdUmYL4ay2sRQMWOEJvaN44ohdBY5INYYTpKPf-qVx-Xoc101MSt483QrGzEBlib3yiARxViLl0bNtjjFXX802esrQ2V2sqaXG112mJ0C23WmHk5v78IY7J3hSh0dt5BJD9sGx9OsgYcbh1Bi3mtKTyp4IjAkZ91b1JXMF4rX-x8ki88QYESl7RY6fQfDAV3akDgfaDd4BnOAaOZ2lJbsqD-Z_gxnQkQBSNnQSmugVg1OvRPE5nXKIYclP-caY18EnnAVE6fFfBVQKIVtULiU0vIYgVZhPeoCJieshzkdjz__kqMQkev7RPdk3oyB7khBcSoD6ig8OZwfbEugpjz4QPH1v-qw-mtcNOjH9bSjM5YvCOEiQ6RvTHHuEuCUuWz1yj6-UaIH8XkoifoCHp) [No](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2ddb1909d57b49e8a7d4fb0c98a9971e&_e=POr175x3_blJrB6CeaOntYyC1BSOmPNbOtR0DRYwHU8EMsdUmYL4ay2sRQMWOEJvaN44ohdBY5INYYTpKPf-qVx-Xoc101MSt483QrGzEBlib3yiARxViLl0bNtjjFXX802esrQ2V2sqaXG112mJ0C23WmHk5v78IY7J3hSh0dt5BJD9sGx9OsgYcbh1Bi3mtKTyp4IjAkZ91b1JXMF4rX-x8ki88QYESl7RY6fQfDAV3akDgfaDd4BnOAaOZ2lJbsqD-Z_gxnQkQBSNnQSmutR6RzdGBvt59aHMgz6whETS-wTOA4xEfF4QVStUkqY8ilElAi3Di9gwcF965XRUVgpKdKDZxTRZN-U9nJ3FbV3aZaMfTyIXLw7L_3frP4xWPEnG-K1-hKhgDNqZl0JNRZwP_jy0AW4MxkRE2lvKLxe59B4tOwxCbewvdMau6z21) [Not Sure / Don't Know](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=2ddb1909d57b49e8a7d4fb0c98a9971e&_e=POr175x3_blJrB6CeaOntYyC1BSOmPNbOtR0DRYwHU8EMsdUmYL4ay2sRQMWOEJvaN44ohdBY5INYYTpKPf-qVx-Xoc101MSt483QrGzEBlib3yiARxViLl0bNtjjFXX802esrQ2V2sqaXG112mJ0C23WmHk5v78IY7J3hSh0dt5BJD9sGx9OsgYcbh1Bi3mtKTyp4IjAkZ91b1JXMF4rX-x8ki88QYESl7RY6fQfDAV3akDgfaDd4BnOAaOZ2lJbsqD-Z_gxnQkQBSNnQSmulVSspCoW0jRfD2NtgAF5pluZwhpDENAdVDNQYsgVrqD2Rq35rS0fTW7QhQuggWjB7T6r9suw85Ah8jYXGP3Jvj37vqh9WlAPxgYJYMpiOBlbXACA2O4FBGges3MNrpwW8bmmWbfNPePlRzGL5juUnDsY6jyDylzqkfhpqpgwSbz) We need more citizens like you--_informed citizens_ --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the **CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS**. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand
* WHAT the Constitution says;
* HOW it relates to current issues and events; and
* WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty.

If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. **You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. ** That's because we're seeking _1,000 people_ in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to _10,000,000 Americans_ , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the **National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! clean_body: You are an informed citizen—I believe that wholeheartedly. | | Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | | Good day, fellow American. You are an informed citizen--I believe that wholeheartedly. You love this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S. Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty that define our nation. Do you believe it is important for Americans to have basic knowledge of American history and civics, including knowledge about the Constitution? We need more citizens like you--informed citizens --because America is at a turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism. The country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We can't let that happen! That's why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of Hillsdale College and our nationwide initiative--the CAMPAIGN FOR INFORMED CITIZENS. We are the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal of this campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable Americans who understand WHAT the Constitution says; HOW it relates to current issues and events; and WHY the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to liberty. If this campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people, that our education system failed. These are young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history in school. You are essential to the success of this effort to make America more knowledgeable. That's because we're seeking 1,000 people in each state to help us teach the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to 10,000,000 Americans , and this initiative starts with you--YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights. And we must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you who want what's best for the country. So please, share your opinions by completing the National Survey on the State of American Education **today at the link below. Thank you for reading my email! For our children, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College .

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87665358/481865717/1328794144?refcode=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQwMmVhNzViLTAwMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LxMPRdxNJVuCeSrIlZeTAk-YBxREkwZNGtiO18NpMAM=&emci=aac2f2ae-f033-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)

I recently had the privilege to sit down with _Rolling Stone_ to talk about the climate crisis, my journey through activism, and why this November's election is so crucial. I'd love to share some of my thoughts _(and hopefully even inspire you to stay active in the climate fight!)_ But first, I have a personal request: **[We're just a few days away from a pretty big end-of-quarter deadline, and we're aiming for an ambitious goal of $25,000. Every single donation will help us empower bold climate champions and make a real difference. Would you be able to chip in a few dollars?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87665359/481865718/-1987279562?refcode=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQwMmVhNzViLTAwMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LxMPRdxNJVuCeSrIlZeTAk-YBxREkwZNGtiO18NpMAM=)** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87665360/481865719/-1987279562?refcode=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.402ea75b-0034-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQwMmVhNzViLTAwMzQtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LxMPRdxNJVuCeSrIlZeTAk-YBxREkwZNGtiO18NpMAM=) I've always believed that if you want to go fast, go alone. But if you want to go far, go together. Joining an organization, participating in a protest, or simply engaging in conversations with others who share your values can be incredibly rewarding. It was through meeting like-minded individuals that I transitioned from a life of hedonism to one dedicated to activism back in 1970. I met people who were living for something bigger than themselves, and it was like peering through a keyhole into a world we were striving to create. These days, it’s the climate crisis that consumes me. In 2022, I co-founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC to elect candidates who will push back against the corrupting influence of the fossil fuel industry and prioritize science-backed climate action. The fossil fuel industry is a wounded beast right now. They know fossil fuels are on their way out, so they're poking holes all over the place, trying to squeeze out the last drop of oil or gas to ratchet up profits. This reckless push for profits is creating a public health crisis — our air, water, and soil are being contaminated, leading to a rise in asthma, cancer, strokes, and other serious health issues. We can't let them endanger our communities any longer. As we inch closer to the election in November, the stakes have never been higher. This is an existential election. Who becomes president will have a massive impact on whether we have a livable future. And it’s not just about the presidency. Down-ballot races — city councils, state legislators, boards of supervisors, mayors — that’s where the robust work on climate is happening. And this is what the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is all about. Our mission is to fund and support candidates up and down the ballot who are committed to bold, fearless climate action. We are dedicated to creating a future where our children and grandchildren can thrive in a healthy, sustainable environment. This isn't just about one election — it's about building lasting change. I can't think about anything else. I go to sleep on it. I wake up thinking about it. I will fight for climate action until the day I die. clean_body: Can you guess what it is? | I recently had the privilege to sit down with Rolling Stone to talk about the climate crisis, my journey through activism, and why this November's election is so crucial. I'd love to share some of my thoughts (and hopefully even inspire you to stay active in the climate fight!) But first, I have a personal request: = = I've always believed that if you want to go fast, go alone. But if you want to go far, go together. Joining an organization, participating in a protest, or simply engaging in conversations with others who share your values can be incredibly rewarding. It was through meeting like-minded individuals that I transitioned from a life of hedonism to one dedicated to activism back in 1970. I met people who were living for something bigger than themselves, and it was like peering through a keyhole into a world we were striving to create. These days, it’s the climate crisis that consumes me. In 2022, I co-founded the Jane Fonda Climate PAC to elect candidates who will push back against the corrupting influence of the fossil fuel industry and prioritize science-backed climate action. The fossil fuel industry is a wounded beast right now. They know fossil fuels are on their way out, so they're poking holes all over the place, trying to squeeze out the last drop of oil or gas to ratchet up profits. This reckless push for profits is creating a public health crisis — our air, water, and soil are being contaminated, leading to a rise in asthma, cancer, strokes, and other serious health issues. We can't let them endanger our communities any longer. As we inch closer to the election in November, the stakes have never been higher. This is an existential election. Who becomes president will have a massive impact on whether we have a livable future. And it’s not just about the presidency. Down-ballot races — city councils, state legislators, boards of supervisors, mayors — that’s where the robust work on climate is happening. And this is what the Jane Fonda Climate PAC is all about. Our mission is to fund and support candidates up and down the ballot who are committed to bold, fearless climate action. We are dedicated to creating a future where our children and grandchildren can thrive in a healthy, sustainable environment. This isn't just about one election — it's about building lasting change. I can't think about anything else. I go to sleep on it. I wake up thinking about it. I will fight for climate action until the day I die. Because, you know, if we started doing everything correctly right now, my four-year-old grandson would be living in a pretty cool world in 25 years. Now that’s worth fighting for. So, I urge you to get involved. Vote with climate in mind. Encourage your friends and family to do the same. I was born and raised in Akron, Ohio, and grew up on the city’s west side. Both of my parents served as elected leaders in Ohio, and I saw exactly what it was like to be an elected official. My mother was the first Black woman to serve on Akron City Council at-large. It’s because of them that I felt responsible for my community and decided to run for state representative. For eight years, I served as State Representative for Ohio House District 34. But one of my biggest challenges in office was being constantly told that I did not look like a legislator. And that’s because there had never been a Black woman under the age of 30 to be elected to the state legislature before me.

_**That’s why CO State Rep. Leslie Herod and I founded the Emerge Seated Together program—because so many Black women share the same experience of being told they don’t belong in elected office and challenged for wanting to serve their communities.**_ The Emerge Seated Together program brings together Black women from across the country to give them not just the confidence but the tools they need to win. It is an advanced leadership program designed for Black women elected and formerly elected officials who are ready to take the next step in advancing within their political journey – and it works. Black women deserve a seat at the table in order to address their communities’ most urgent issues, including access to reproductive care. In Ohio, our communities voted overwhelmingly to pass Issue 1 in 2023, which enshrined abortion rights in our constitution. I need more Black Democratic women by my side to keep up the fight to protect and expand access to our most basic freedoms nationwide. clean_body: We’re grateful for Rep. Emilia Sykes in her pivotal role in co-founding the Seated Together leadership program. | Did you see yesterday’s important message from Rep. Emilia Sykes, Peter? We’re grateful for Rep. Emilia Sykes in her pivotal role in co-founding the Seated Together leadership program, which focuses on the unique challenges and additional barriers to entry that Black women face as they seek to deepen their impact and move up the political pipeline. = | = | = | = | = | = Read Rep. Sykes message below: = HiPeter, I’m Emilia Sykes, and I represent Ohio’s 13th Congressional District in Congress. I’m also a proud Emerge alum. = | = I was born and raised in Akron, Ohio, and grew up on the city’s west side. Both of my parents served as elected leaders in Ohio, and I saw exactly what it was like to be an elected official. My mother was the first Black woman to serve on Akron City Council at-large. It’s because of them that I felt responsible for my community and decided to run for state representative. For eight years, I served as State Representative for Ohio House District 34. But one of my biggest challenges in office was being constantly told that I did not look like a legislator. And that’s because there had never been a Black woman under the age of 30 to be elected to the state legislature before me. That’s why CO State Rep. Leslie Herod and I founded the Emerge Seated Together program—because so many Black women share the same experience of being told they don’t belong in elected office and challenged for wanting to serve their communities. The Emerge Seated Together program brings together Black women from across the country to give them not just the confidence but the tools they need to win. It is an advanced leadership program designed for Black women elected and formerly elected officials who are ready to take the next step in advancing within their political journey – and it works. Black women deserve a seat at the table in order to address their communities’ most urgent issues, including access to reproductive care. In Ohio, our communities voted overwhelmingly to pass Issue 1 in 2023, which enshrined abortion rights in our constitution. I need more Black Democratic women by my side to keep up the fight to protect and expand access to our most basic freedoms nationwide. Emerge just announced Seated Together’s third cohort of trailblazing Black women preparing to run for higher office. But it takes significant resources, and that’s why we are turning to you for help. body:
River Gassen wins Democratic nomination for U.S. House in Colorado's 5th Congressional District | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/campaign-update-and-more-8324830?e=3818d77efc)
---
[](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=28777120f2&e=3818d77efc)
|
# We won the primaries!

The Associate Press declared earlier today that River Gassen is the Democratic nominee for U.S. House in Colorado’s 5th Congressional District

It’s the result of hard work, and simply putting in the hours to be willing to reach people - we canvassed 1000s of doors, called 1000s of people, worked overtime and had many late nights - and won by less than 500 votes against corporate PAC money.

And we’ll do it all again.

There’s no secrete. The Koch brother’s are out to destroy the planet. Scientist have been telling us for over a century now that the excessive greenhouse gasses are warming our atmosphere, and that fossil fuel and oil production is the blame. Not only do the Koch brother’s profit off of climate misinformation, but the Republican party does too. They have been poring money into this race because they know it’s up for grabs.
We must make a clear message. Colorado is not for sale.

Todays victory showcases the power of the people. the power of individual donations, and the power of individual effort. Not a single dollar was wasted. Every text sent out, and yard sign, every hour our team worked - came together for our victory.
Your support means more now than it ever has before. Early money funds a team, it helps us organize, and gives us the time we need. We need to protect Colorado’s rivers and protect our planet.

Donate now to secure a victory for Colorado’s 5th Congressional District - and to give Democrats the majority this November.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/river-gassen-for-congress-1

Thank you for considering this special way to support our campaign.
With heartfelt thanks,River Gassen

If you haven't gotten a chance to meet him yet - don't worry - there are plenty of opportunities coming up! _**CAMPAIGN NEWS**_ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87666605/481869633/1938203091?refcode=240626_wi_newsletter_img&ms=240626_wi_newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODJiM2Q1OTMtMDMzNC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=LP_RyqpL92_fdcVEIFBGfAYN1OtIEvCEBOhEl98oNWk=)** Milwaukee State Convention: Eric’s speech knocked it out of the park! Eric is listening to what our needs are in District 3 and it shows. body:
But with a critical deadline closing in, with millions in attack ads against me, and with a new poll showing Kari Lake leading by 1 point, I need you more than ever.

| Peter —

I know I’ve been emailing a lot lately with urgent requests. But I want you to know just how important you are to this campaign. When I think of my most important supporters, it’s not about how much they’ve given.

I think about the people who were there when I needed them most. Almost 225,000 people have contributed to this campaign — far more than I ever expected.

**But with a critical deadline closing in, with millions in attack ads against me, and with a new poll showing Kari Lake leading by 1 point, I need you more than ever.**

I have to be honest with you: The last couple months haven’t been our strongest. We’re missing fundraising goals and that’s having an impact on our campaign. We can’t afford to miss our goal in June, too.

So, if you can afford it, and if you’re as committed to victory in Arizona as I am, please:

[_**Can you please make a split contribution of $10 to my campaign for U.S. Senate and Fight for Progress? Help us hit these goals and take back Arizona’s seat. name: John Fetterman
subject: How we protect our rights 🏳️‍🌈🏳️‍⚧️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
It has been nine years since the court established the right for LGBTQ+ couples to get married in the landmark decision Obergefell v. Hodges.
#
We are never ever going back, Derek! 🙅♂️
**It has been nine years since the court established the right for LGBTQ+ couples to get married in the landmark decision _Obergefell v. Hodges_.**
Conservative extremists on the Supreme Court want to overturn _Obergefell_. Thomas and Alito spelled out their plan to strip equal protection under the law for LGBTQIA+ folks in the _Dobbs_ decision and again in a recent court opinion.
I am committed to never ever going back in time, Derek. There’s too much on the line.
**If we are going to protect our hard-fought victories and basic rights** , we are going to have to do a few things:
* 📜 **Vote to *_finally_ * pass the Equality Act** – which would ensure that civil rights laws, like protections against discrimination in employment and housing, apply to sexual orientation and gender identity.

* 🗳️ **Elect Joe Biden** – The Supreme Court has turned conservative because of the three Trump-appointed justices that have created upheaval in our lives. We need a Democrat in the White House so that future Justices can help to re-balance the court.

* 🔵 **Keep the Senate Blue** – When Joe Biden appoints the next Supreme Court Justice, we are going to need a majority in the Senate to approve his appointment. **This is critical!**

In honor of the 9th anniversary of _Obergefell_ , I am going to ask you today to make a split contribution between my campaign and the campaign to re-elect Joe Biden.
[**In this crucial moment, will you sit back and let the conservative SCOTUS take away even more of our rights OR will you make a split contribution of $5 to help keep the Senate blue and elect Joe Biden this November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240626?refcode=em20240626&amount=5&refcode2=9157_434096_F8xKQz&akid=9157%2E434096%2EF8xKQz)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240626?amount=5&refcode=em20240626-9157&refcode2=9157_434096_F8xKQz&akid=9157%2E434096%2EF8xKQz)**
Let’s make sure we see the 10th anniversary of _Obergefell_. 🏳️🌈🏳️⚧️
❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240626?refcode=em20240626&amount=5&refcode2=9157_434096_F8xKQz&akid=9157%2E434096%2EF8xKQz)

I remember vividly trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft.** The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

clean_body: From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through the Respect for Marriage Act, Tammy Baldwin worked hard every day since to do just that. | | | | We have made incredible progress over the years in the fight for equality — but we cannot mistake progress for total victory. Republican-led state legislatures across the country continue to put passing harmful legislation, especially legislation targeting the transgender community and LGBTQ+ youth, at the top of their agenda. In 2024 alone, over 520 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced across the country. It's going to take all of us – and strong Democratic leaders – to counter these right-wing attacks so everyone grows up knowing they belong and that kindness and inclusion — not hatred and division — are American values. That's why I'm putting the spotlight on my friend Senator Tammy Baldwin's reelection campaign in Wisconsin. = When Tammy became the first openly gay Senator elected in our nation's history, she understood that she needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. From lowering prescription drug prices to protecting same-sex marriage through leading the fight to pass the Respect for Marriage Act, she's worked hard every day since to do just that. That's why she ran for office in the first place — not to make history, but to make a difference, and she does that every day in the Senate. Tammy is one of my most valuable allies in the Senate because she's willing to take on the hard fights against the powerful to protect the rights and interests of regular folks. = = Onward! | | Peter Since November 8, 2022, the day I won my race for Congress – I have made it my mission to push partisan politics aside and put the American people above **everything** else. subject: Capitol & Campaign Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=edbb21c664&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

The Joint Legislative Budget Committee released a link to the final budget we voted on in mid-June for FY 2025. You can read the budget for yourself [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4b268c65b2&e=a7ab36849c).

On June 17th, as a Club for Growth [fellow](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=14032c11c8&e=a7ab36849c) I had a chance to participate in an afternoon webinar with David McIntosh about his upcoming policy book. He discussed everything from school choice to taxes.

On June 18th, I was invited to tour Arizona Autism Charter School’s new [entrepreneurial training center](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c5fee797a4&e=a7ab36849c). This new center aptly dubbed “Essential Piece Enterprises” will offer job and career-readiness programs for 18- to 22-year-old high school students, as well as adults on autism spectrum who are entering the workforce. They will have a coffee shop, a silk screening and “merch” retail shop, a shipping and receiving center, and a tech repair area along with a coding center. I very much look forward to returning this fall to see how their summer training went.

Later in the day, I helped giveaway supply kits to Valley teachers’ courtesy of Four Peaks Brewing. If you are interested in partnering with Four Peaks on this amazing outreach for our teachers, please visit their [website](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=68afb65e76&e=a7ab36849c) to learn how. Thank you to Trevor for the invite to help hand out supply kits. Here’s a little local [press](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bb272ad861&e=a7ab36849c) on their charity for teachers.

Just because the legislature Sine Die on June 15th, it doesn’t mean I somehow got a vacation. I continue to conduct constituent calls and meetings for District 2 and help with serving constituent issues each week.

_Signed and Vetoed Legislation_

Last week, Hobbs signed two of my bills and vetoed one so let’s start with the bad news.

Hobbs vetoed one of my bills last week that would have protected our public-school children from sex crimes in their school setting. [Senate Bill 1435](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=090512d05d&e=a7ab36849c) would have subjected a public entity to liability for losses arising out of an act or omission by a public employee that is determined to be a felony sexual offense under certain circumstances. The bill passed both chambers with bipartisan support.

I introduced this much needed legislation because I care about the safety of our children. During the interim in 2023, I met with a few individuals from around our state whose district school children received unwanted sexual advances by school employees. I believe all families with school-aged children attending our district and charter schools should have the confidence in knowing there are adequate safety measures in place where their kids will be spending many hours learning each day.

This measure would have held all public entities liable if an employee commits a sexual crime against a child and they previously failed to investigate allegations of sexual misconduct against that employee or failed to conduct a proper background check.

After these incidents, each family shared with me that they were told the school conducted background checks prior to hiring these employees, but it turns out this wasn’t always the case, even though it is required. Sadly, these children were failed by the adults within their educational setting who were supposed to look out for their best interests and protect them.

Our public-school officials need to be held to a very high level of accountability, ensuring current and future employees who will be working with our children are properly vetted before they are hired and begin engaging with our children. Hopefully, our public entities understand this responsibility now more than ever when it comes to keeping our children safe by properly conducting background checks during the hiring process, or, if an alleged violation of written policies arises, they thoroughly investigate the situation.

Sadly, Hobbs’ top priority isn’t keeping our children safe in their public schools otherwise she would not have vetoed Senate Bill 1435. In my opinion, one Arizona child who is victimized is one too many.

Hobbs also signed the Sex Offender Management Board into law, [Senate Bill 1630](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=448815be2a&e=a7ab36849c). SB 1630 will bring a sex offender management board to Arizona. Our state needs more oversight, transparency, and accountability for how sex offender cases are managed, supervised, and treated. Many states including Colorado have a similar board comprised of experts in the field weighing in on how these cases should be managed. This board will make recommendations to the legislature and create uniform standards for these types of cases based on research.

I worked with an amazing Dodie Londen sister from the same graduating class as me who worked as a manager in our county’s Adult Probation Department for more than 14 years. This board is modeled after the State of Colorado and is considered the gold standard for sex offender management across the country.

We believe this will help change the landscape in our criminal justice system for the better. As a mom, you should know by now I truly care about our children and victims’ rights. We believe this board will further improve transparency and accountability in our government. Hopefully, this management board will help how sex cases are managed and handled across our 15 counties in Arizona. According to the individual I worked with on this bill, Arizona’s sex cases have been managed in darkness and secrecy for decades like how sex offenses occur. Even though this bill was initially drafted by me in 2022, during the interim it was co-drafted with Representative Alexander Kolodin with the support of Senate President Warren Petersen. This bill was also voted out in a bipartisan fashion.

If you get a chance, you should go back and watch or listen to the testimony in the Senate on this bill. We had psychologists, specialized sex offense therapists and a victims’ parent come in in support of this bill. I hope this bill helps protect Arizona children, families and victims of sex offenses moving forward.

Finally, Hobbs signed our lemonade stand bill, [Senate Bill 1370](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=aded15fda9&e=a7ab36849c). The legislation will “prohibit a municipality or county from requiring a license or permit for a business that operates occasionally by a minor or a person who has not graduated from high school, [and] creates a transaction privilege tax (TPT) exemption.” In today’s world, it is certain we need to let kids flourish and soak up the entrepreneurial spirit, not regulate their imagination and grit before they can even launch their idea.

I believe asking kids to obtain a food handlers card to set up a lemonade stand is absurd. Yet, cities across Arizona had been requiring this unnecessary bureaucratic step. I don’t agree with saddling our budding innovators with red tape. Now, they can without local government interference because of SB 1370. We had no Democratic senators vote in support of this bill, but we had quite a few Democrat House members vote yes. Otherwise, it would have been a party line vote bill and Hobbs would have most likely vetoed this important bill allowing youth entrepreneurs to simply sell lemonade even though it has passed and been signed into law in some blue states.

_Along the Campaign Trail_

One of the local papers started to cover District 2 and my competitive primary and general races. The _Daily Independent_ asked each of us some questions and this is how I responded:

**Shawnna Bolick (R)**

**Why are you running for LD2 State House of Representatives?**

I was recruited back to the legislature to be a check on Hobbs’ radical agenda. I have supported common sense economic policies so everyday Arizonans can keep a roof over their heads, fuel in their car’s gas tank and food on the table amidst failed top-down government policies coming out of DC.

**What do you think are the top two challenges facing the district in the next five years?**

1.) District 2 is adjacent to TSMC. Housing is being built in our district to accommodate future TSMC employees. The area is already gripped with limited, affordable housing options.
2.) With an open border, more families will continue to be challenged with the rise in fentanyl. Teens continue to buy drugs on social media that are sometimes laced with a deadly dose of fentanyl.

**In your opinion, what are the two key issues driving voters to the polls this election and where do you stand on those issues?**

1.) Bidenflation is up nearly 20% since Biden took office. Our families are weary of our current economy and can’t afford this pay cut. I led the charge to get rid of the municipal food tax levy in 2019 and then, in 2022, to get rid of the residential rental tax. We’re all getting less for our money than we got before Biden came into office.
2.) The state legislature will refer the Secure the Border Act to the ballot to give voters the ability to safeguard Arizona’s communities since the Feds have failed to secure our wide-open border.

I received primary endorsements from the Arizona Multihousing Association and the Freedom Club PAC last week.

Fellow Patriot,

I am honored to have served the people of Texas as a Texas Supreme Court Justice, Attorney General, and now, Governor of Texas.

_**Ever since I first took public office, this has been the #1 most searched questions about me: **_
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89byvIyokWif8PpDP7o2Ev1Kb5oS-0oIG4N6vlO6YU8GcAPTd3GrcdwyUt7nYpqyCRlpcMDAop2YfKoggg8JxsaswR4y1no1O865YyARSDLJTmBdX9T85EsD3VDC-esqPHNRChgQWf1c-f0Vabv-QCpAQs6U6u9-lFD8RfPgV-jq_Q%3D%3D)
**[Here's the story about how a sudden accident changed my life forever 39 years ago:](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89byvIyokWif8PpDP7o2Ev1KdYlVXR4ED85-slpOIjxzHeZAKJ9HlBwHC5Nk-G5iuGd9eXROb5kvdb4239c7diWx-bEkZcTVtwqsPdHn4brpD3rcb_sXilV3QhRf5RXp-Kt-kJaIiOqrfBja11Vc9McnDdJTshcQ1LRBANwAE6KyBg%3D%3D)**
I was out for a jog when an explosion of sound occurred. The next thing I knew, I was down in excruciating pain, and it felt like a sledgehammer had been taken to my back.

A large tree had fallen on me, and after being rushed to the hospital, I soon learned that I was permanently paralyzed from the waist down.
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89byvIyokWif8PpDP7o2Ev1Kxa6k1TJ-QPEpjru8U3T_baGPSUifNo6oIRgZni3NW0gbHWkG-b6o1-SRGI9zZE7VmeW_JgiE7O9tbXcswNfTbjk8OjPMz38Hb7l-wJXZpifCSYmWGEfts8Fp16Xu8-fO89DeMI21C0ijUJRMFQIo0Q%3D%3D)
When you're lying in bed throttled with pain, you have to apply lessons you've learned all your life. For me, that lesson was _**perseverance.**_

My faith in God and His plan for me, along with the support of my family, helped me to keep going.
**Our lives are not defined by our challenges, but by how we respond to those challenges.**
_This rings true for our state and its people, too. _

Recently, Texas has faced unimaginable challenges to keep our border and our nation secure.

In response, we've taken unprecedented action to defend Texans and Americans through Operation Lone Star, including: transporting migrants to sanctuary cities, building our own border wall, installing razor wire and anti-climb barriers, and seizing enough fentanyl to kill every man, woman, and child in the United States.
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89aBCqYmAmnHLlq_5m58zls8e2KglP1ofeNtu0jhwwg6Mssw5euYMo1AbdOsRz53dZsUJDM_wh3Md2733qKYmbF3iwsfCuP_6Yev2prkGSYMwHWZT-APVVGopQzcer-zGkkHbQzMRCuQADhF7_Y9KK_-YV7TjkpshVZ7jFWRGcU8npVE2gxJui1daFBWxVTHZHhh5Tq8ArT1lmI5Gw2SzbB6umgXxmZkZeyv8m3mQJMG9GN7X6aMMt-5lQyQ8mJtWRyuzLteNnkux0Jvq84fDCd_)
__**These historic actions made us the target of vicious attacks and lawsuits from the Biden Administration and their allies on the Left.**__

Recently, I signed major border security laws to criminalize illegal entry into Texas from a foreign nation, authorize the removal or imprisonment of illegal immigrants crossing our southern border, and secure more funding for our Texas border wall. _**Texas is being BLOCKED from enforcing one of these critical border security laws as you are reading this.**_
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89byvIyokWif8PpDP7o2Ev1KjlRnj0TiYJUY25wyR-_tgH5Pz4MpnPpV15juIRHWBE7MrdsrsIgyfaOnShdpbkgl6E3pQQ4Byfsd2cne3dYys-IHGyPGi4ktFsqyfLYjaEjD9FZe26Cgcf7jP24iEnEYDxtMwnRN1z4JGI1oqQUSnQ%3D%3D)
Texas continues to endure through challenges and thrive, and I am honored to lead our state through it all, %%=Propercase(first_name_most_recent)=%%.

No matter what challenge or opportunity is thrown our way, Texas remains the best place in the nation to live, work, and raise a family. _This is the result of decades of strong conservative leadership that stays true to Texas values of liberty, personal freedom, law and order, and free enterprise._
**[For our tradition of excellence to continue, we need to make sure Republicans stay in the top leadership roles. Will you contribute a few dollars today to protect our conservative values for generations to come?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9bede6d86b0c4bb89014c18de4237f76&_e=4qv-R2FJmHLndoE1gvOXwOcY0yRJeGd7ja5O9kmu4b8ozFxoamyf4StTpksGvpE7-bUGR5X4UWtjk_8oOmAzB7kAhfGkKnAUleohzLMNec3VPcqPVDFUZNfsDvC_a-vumbK6eR0O4hYnnRnNPOrwTpUguCMP8M9IPF-mgfI5ldOfeWNDo8d8jTbb9j409pxDrDQPBGIkp588YKYTW-2M9kYY7m-Sg58cFj3PN4P_89byvIyokWif8PpDP7o2Ev1K6BGIPG-3RJTY3YVXUQ7T1fWrp41dJdu4f8RbE8HaayWmF1duGqcsEOGRHd4V5L5nluEde16VROj6zXrjUcYZzEtNpGlE0a-Po0JPeg9olUKIaiEhdJrckQIKoRuQwwEXGhWq-soAeoprOHsV3i-mrQ%3D%3D)**
Despite life's challenges, I am blessed to call myself a husband, a father, and a public servant. My family and I love Texas and are proud to call it home. clean_body: 39 years ago, an accident changed my life forever | | | | | | | Untitled Document Fellow Patriot, I am honored to have served the people of Texas as a Texas Supreme Court Justice, Attorney General, and now, Governor of Texas. Ever since I first took public office, this has been the #1 most searched questions about me: I was out for a jog when an explosion of sound occurred. The next thing I knew, I was down in excruciating pain, and it felt like a sledgehammer had been taken to my back. A large tree had fallen on me, and after being rushed to the hospital, I soon learned that I was permanently paralyzed from the waist down. When you're lying in bed throttled with pain, you have to apply lessons you've learned all your life. For me, that lesson was perseverance. My faith in God and His plan for me, along with the support of my family, helped me to keep going. Our lives are not defined by our challenges, but by how we respond to those challenges. This rings true for our state and its people, too. Recently, Texas has faced unimaginable challenges to keep our border and our nation secure. In response, we've taken unprecedented action to defend Texans and Americans through Operation Lone Star, including: transporting migrants to sanctuary cities, building our own border wall, installing razor wire and anti-climb barriers, and seizing enough fentanyl to kill every man, woman, and child in the United States. These historic actions made us the target of vicious attacks and lawsuits from the Biden Administration and their allies on the Left. Recently, I signed major border security laws to criminalize illegal entry into Texas from a foreign nation, authorize the removal or imprisonment of illegal immigrants crossing our southern border, and secure more funding for our Texas border wall. Texas is being BLOCKED from enforcing one of these critical border security laws as you are reading this. Texas continues to endure through challenges and thrive, and I am honored to lead our state through it all, %%=Propercase(firstnamemostrecent)=%%. No matter what challenge or opportunity is thrown our way, Texas remains the best place in the nation to live, work, and raise a family. This is the result of decades of strong conservative leadership that stays true to Texas values of liberty, personal freedom, law and order, and free enterprise. Despite life's challenges, I am blessed to call myself a husband, a father, and a public servant. My family and I love Texas and are proud to call it home. Guided by my faith and commitment to public service, I will continue the fight to make Texas safer, stronger, and more prosperous for generations to come. With gratitude, Governor Greg Abbott POLITICAL AD PAID FOR BY TEXANS FOR GREG ABBOTT PO BOX 308, AUSTIN, TEXAS 78767

clean_body: | | | = I have a big update to share, friend: We just launched a new TV ad to hold my GOP opponent, Sam Brown, accountable for his outrageous and dangerous record of opposition to abortion rights. This ad shares the powerful and heartbreaking story of Valerie, a woman who was forced to flee her home in Texas to seek the vital reproductive care she needed — all because of a radical abortion ban that Brown supported when he was running for office in Texas. Now, Brown is running for Senate to defeat me here in Nevada – once again threatening reproductive rights for millions of women like Valerie across our country. subject: Before this month is up...
disclaimer_text: Paid for By Our Tennessee Future PAC, Not Affiliated with Any Candidate or Candidate Committee [contact us](mailto:info@ourtenn
body:
Tennessee has been named one of the worst states for LGBTQIA+ equality. Let’s change that.

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f019056de5039-b798c6ab-5fa1-4c21-8e60-1aedcd0dbd0e-000000/Rs7pgPJ2gbG0yjSmQrzFTwX5Brk=164)
---
Peter,
---
| | As Pride Month comes to a close across the nation, we must confront a sobering reality here at home. Tennessee has been named one of the worst states for LGBTQIA+ equality, [_according to a recent report_](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.wkrn.com%2Fnews%2Fnational%2Ftennessee-among-worst-states-for-lgbtq-equality-report-finds%2F%3Futm_source=t.co%26utm_medium=referral%26utm_campaign=socialflow/1/010f019056de5039-b798c6ab-5fa1-4c21-8e60-1aedcd0dbd0e-000000/I1HyCrvXctmBIvJEr4P5-WUv9bI=164), and this is the direct responsibility of the MAGA extremists in our legislature.

The rights and freedoms of our LGBTQIA+ friends, family, and neighbors are under siege. Tennessee's legislative landscape is increasingly hostile, with discriminatory laws and policies that marginalize and endanger LGBTQIA+ individuals. From bathroom bills and bans on gender-affirming care, to prohibiting pride flags and endangering transgender children in schools, the attacks are relentless and pervasive.

But we are not powerless. We can fight back.
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_20_PrideMonth/1/010f019056de5039-b798c6ab-5fa1-4c21-8e60-1aedcd0dbd0e-000000/9EuQI1EbJFu8PVyhNU0W_LA7dv4=164 "Donate")
---
Democrats in Tennessee are on the front lines, championing the rights of LGBTQIA+ individuals and working tirelessly to protect our communities from these harmful laws. They are the barrier standing between equality and the oppressive agenda of the far-right. Yet, their fight is far from easy, and they need our support now more than ever. Just this year, GOP Republicans have been on a rampage in Tennessee, let’s review a few of the bills they have passed:

**SB 2766:** Would remove a teacher's obligation to ensure that students are not denied or excluded from important educational programs or benefits on the basis of their family status or their sexual orientation. Would remove the requirement that sex education programs in school be medically accurate.
**SB 1738:** Would explicitly allow people in Tennessee to foster or adopt a child whose sexual orientation or gender identity they refuse to affirm, preventing the state Department of Children’s Services from ensuring that LGBTQ+ youth are placed with supportive caregivers.
**HB 2610:** Would terminate the human rights commission with no wind-down period. Instead of being an independent body, the commission’s duties would fall under a new office reporting to Tennessee’s anti-LGBTQ+ attorney general.

We can’t let these anti-LGBTQ MAGA legislators stay in office and do this to our state. This Pride Month, let's turn our outrage into action. By supporting Democratic candidates, we can help elect leaders who will stand up for LGBTQIA+ rights and work to create a Tennessee that is inclusive, safe, and equitable for all.

Our voices, our votes, and our contributions can make a real difference. Together, we can ensure that Tennessee moves forward, not backward, on the path to equality.
---

---
Please, consider making a donation today. Your contribution will directly support Democratic candidates who are committed to fighting for the rights of the LGBTQIA+ community in Tennessee.
---
In solidarity,
Ann Perry
Our Tennessee Future PAC Team
---
_Our Tennessee Future PAC has been established as a proactive response to the political landscape in Tennessee, which has been taken over by MAGA ideologies. This PAC is dedicated to supporting state-elected officials who represent alternative, more progressive values contrary to those of the MAGA Republicans who currently dominate the state legislature. Key strategies include voter registration drives and targeted advertising campaigns, especially in districts where MAGA-aligned candidates are entrenched or pose a strong threat in upcoming elections. By mobilizing pro-Democratic voters and enhancing electoral participation, Our Tennessee Future PAC aims to effect substantial change and balance within Tennessee's political sphere, ensuring the state's policies and leadership accurately reflect the diverse perspectives of its residents. Your donation helps us in this fight.___

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

We’ll be honest, this isn’t the email we hoped to send you.

After being pummeled with $20 million from right-wing outside spending,
Rep. Jamaal Bowman has lost his primary election in NY-16. This was the
most expensive House primary in U.S. electoral history, with Republican
megadonors using AIPAC’s Super PAC to spend over $17 million against our
progressive incumbent.

Despite this disappointing news, Jamaal remains one of the most
transformational leaders of our generation. He has become a political
force who, alongside the rest of the Squad, has changed the trajectory of
American politics and the urgency we expect from our elected leaders.

We recruited Jamaal to run for Congress in 2020 because his life’s work
has been deeply rooted in serving his community — as a loving father,
husband, and community leader serving children and working families as a
principal and leading advocate for public education in NYC for over 15
years.

Jamaal was an underdog from the beginning, with our progressive movement
always facing an uphill battle. From the moment Justice Democrats
candidates are recruited to run, they are up against decades of
establishment infrastructure and multi-million dollar war chests fueled by
right-wing millionaires and billionaires.

The work of Justice Democrats is to break down the barriers that exist for
people like Jamaal Bowman to run for Congress. Through your contributions,
we have:

* Worked directly with Jamaal’s campaign to help them knock on 170,000
doors and make over 1,000,000 phone calls to voters this calendar
year;
* Raised the campaign over $200,000 directly from all of you on our
email list;
* Spent more than $1,300,000 on the independent expenditure side, making
us the largest outside group spender supporting Jamaal;
* Poured hundreds of staff hours into the campaign, stepping into key
management and communications roles when gaps existed, and closely
coordinating with and supporting Jamaal’s campaign staff.

Jamaal’s historic victory over 30+ year AIPAC darling Rep. Eliot Engel and
his courage on many key issues, especially on Israel’s genocide, made him
a top target.

Jamaal and our movement were such a threat to right-wing power, to GOP
megadonors, and to AIPAC’s influence in Congress that they had to spend
$15 million to defeat us. This demonstrates the power of our people-funded
movement, the strength that any single progressive with the moral clarity
to stand up to far-right interests has, and just how on defense AIPAC
really is.

For AIPAC — the single largest spender in American politics including the
presidency to date — this race is so much bigger than re-electing a

| Peter,

California's agricultural industry is vital to the economy and deeply rooted in the hard work and dedication of migrant farmworkers. As the country's **#1 agricultural producer,** it’s safe to say that our country is fueled by and relies on farmworkers.

Despite their immense contributions, migrant farmworkers continue to face systemic challenges, including _inadequate access to healthcare, housing, and fair wages. Not to mention, they’re facing one of the harshest summers to date due to climate change._

**Protecting our migrant workers protects our economy.**
